content.comment_body: Hello. When there is a power outage and the network reconnects afterwards, the values set through the web interface using the analog flag are not retained. Can someone suggest how to configure it so the values are saved?
Please update your topic title to English. Instead of saving values in an analog flag, consider using a parameter within a mathematical instruction.

analysis.insight_summary: Users encounter a problem where values assigned to analog flags via the web interface do not persist after power interruptions and subsequent network restoration. This highlights a lack of persistent or non-volatile storage for parameters set through the web interface, impacting reliability in situations that require data retention.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the values modified for analog flags through the web interface to be automatically saved and then restored after any power loss and network reconnection.
